body:
Post-merge PathPilot Hub check on the 8L lathe simulator (PathPilot v2.14.4), 2026-11-14 22:02-22:07 local. Files: this PR's inch goldens at 9acdd7e8 (the merged head).

| File | Result |
|---|---|
| turning_inch.nc | ran to M30, no alarm, cycle 00:00:42, last line 264 |
| thread_g76_inch.nc | ran to M30, no alarm, cycle 00:00:04, last line 19 |
| axial_drill_inch.nc | ran to M30, no alarm, cycle 00:00:28, last line 21 |

The moves around G30 are one axis at a time. Example, axial_drill_inch: after `G30` / `T0101` it goes `G0 Z1.1811`, then `G0 X0`, then `G0 Z0.7874`. The departure is `G0 X0 Z1.1811` (along the axis), then `G0 X0.9449`, then `G30`. No move passed through the bar in the preview.

Only one stored G30 position was used (the simulator's current one). The second case in the check list (G30 beside the bar, behind the face) was not run.
